title: 第17章  你要对我负责第18章  指挥官先生你想干嘛
slug: 恶女超会撩深陷兽夫雄竞修罗场
content_zh:
季欢没想到，裴西川会做这样的决定。
杨万野立马往季欢的腿扑了过来，抱着她的脚，带着哭声说。
“季欢，帮我跟裴总说说好话，以前都是我眼瞎，分不清真钻石和假钻石。以后，我不会了，我会好好的伺候着你。”
公司的总裁在求她，还说伺候她。
季欢莫名觉得有点诡异，这就是权力？
裴西川看他竟然敢抱季欢的腿，他伸过皮鞋，踢了踢他的手。
“松开，她也是你能碰的？”
杨万里赶紧松开她的腿，往后退了退，他一直看着季欢，在求她，求她帮他说句好话。
季欢倒是很想说，让他滚吧！
昨天她受的气，她难过的心情，都是这家伙给的。
不过，她不想做的那么绝。
这杨万里看着一把年纪，还有家要养，要是她断了他的后路。
他会不会报复自己呢？
她一个外来的灵魂，还是不惹事为好，走好剧情就行。
“杨总，以后别为难我就好，开除你这种事，还是裴总决定为好！”
裴西川在她的脸上亲了一口。
“那行，先留着你，看你能不能把季欢伺候开心了，如果他再不开心，你就滚蛋！”
李万里总算是松了一口气。
“谢谢裴总，谢谢季欢！”
季欢看时间不早了，她抬眸，漂亮的眼睛看着裴西川。

“裴总，我去工作了！”
裴西川松开她的腰，她起身，离开了总裁办公室。
季欢回了三楼的设计部，她一进设计部，所有人都朝她看了过来。
米淇一脸心疼。
“欢欢，你来办离职吗？”
她往季欢的身边走，抱住她。
白雾眠冷冷的看着她，虽然季欢是程永夜的朋友，可是一个平民，她压根就看不上。
而且，进了这个公司，她才知道，季欢确实很有设计天分。
如果，不把她挤走，白雾眠觉得会影响她的前途。
没想到，她才来了一天，她就被开除了，她都没动手脚呢！
老天都在帮她。
季欢笑着说：“我来上班呀！”
米淇以为她不知道。
“杨总把你开除了，你还不知道吧？”
季欢挑了一下眉，“听说了，不过，我没想过要离职，工作吧！”
content_en:
Ji Huan didn't expect Pei Xichuan to make such a decision.
Yang Wanye immediately rushed towards Ji Huan's legs, hugged her feet and said with a cry.
"Ji Huan, please help me say something nice to Mr. Pei. I was blind before and couldn't tell the difference between real diamonds and fake diamonds. From now on, I won't be able to do that anymore, and I will serve you well."
The president of the company begged her and said he would serve her.
Ji Huan felt a little weird for no reason. Is this power?
Pei Xichuan saw that he dared to hug Ji Huan's leg, so he stretched out his leather shoes and kicked his hand.
"Let go, she is also something you can touch?"
Yang Wanli quickly let go of her legs and stepped back. He kept looking at Ji Huan, begging her to say a nice word to him.
Ji Huan really wanted to say, let him go!
The anger she felt yesterday and the sadness she felt were all caused by this guy.
However, she didn't want to be so absolute.
Yang Wanli looked young and had a family to support, so if she cut off his future.
Will he take revenge on himself?
She's an alien soul, so it's better not to cause trouble and just follow the plot.
"Mr. Yang, just don't embarrass me in the future. It's better for Mr. Pei to decide whether to fire you!"
Pei Xichuan kissed her on the face.
"Okay, I'll keep you for now and see if you can make Ji Huan happy. If he's not happy anymore, get out!"
Li Wanli finally breathed a sigh of relief.
"Thank you, Mr. Pei, thank you Ji Huan!"
Ji Huan saw that it was getting late. She raised her eyes and looked at Pei Xichuan with her beautiful eyes.
"Mr. Pei, I'm going to work!"
Pei Xichuan let go of her waist, she stood up and left the president's office.
Ji Huan returned to the design department on the third floor. As soon as she entered the design department, everyone looked at her.
Mi Qi looked distressed.
"Huanhuan, are you here to handle the resignation?"
She walked towards Ji Huan and hugged her.
Bai Wumian looked at her coldly. Although Ji Huan was Cheng Yongye's friend, she didn't like him at all as a commoner.
Moreover, after joining this company, she realized that Ji Huan did have a talent for design.
If she was not squeezed away, Bai Wumian felt that it would affect her future.
Unexpectedly, she was fired after just one day here, and she didn't even do anything!
God is helping her.
Ji Huan smiled and said, "I'm coming to work!"
Mi Qi thought she didn't know.
"Mr. Yang fired you, you still don't know, right?"
Ji Huan raised his eyebrows and said, "I heard that, but I haven't thought about leaving my job. Just work!"
